episodes.synopsis: Enter Milk Chan (Japanese: ミルクちゃん登場の巻), also known as "Milk Chan has Arrived" in the straight dub and "You Play with Fire, You Get Burned" in the Americanized dub, is the first episode of the 1998 series.
episodes.title: Milk Chan Has Arrived

episodes.synopsis: Something Like a Tokarev (Japanese: トカレフの、ようなものの巻), also known as "The High Price of Fame" in the Americanized dub, is the second episode of the 1998 series.
episodes.title: Something Like a Tokarev

episodes.synopsis: It's Ecology, Milk Chan! (Japanese: エコロジーだよミルクちゃんの巻), also known as "The Case of The Endangered Species" in the Americanized dub, is the third episode of the 1998 series.
episodes.title: It's Ecology, Milk-Chan!

episodes.synopsis: Totally Unexpected Animal Event (Japanese: アニマル奇想天外の巻), known as "What the Duck?" in the Americanized dub, is the fourth episode of the 1998 series.
episodes.title: Totally Unexpected Animal Event

episodes.synopsis: Milk's Challenger of Fire (Japanese: ミルクの炎のチャレンジャーの巻), also known as "Don't Play with Fire" in the Americanized dub, is the fifth episode of the 1998 series.
episodes.title: Milk's Challenger of Fire

episodes.synopsis: Milk's Appraise Anything Team (Japanese: ミルクのなんでも鑑定隊の巻), also known as "Have a Knife Day" in the Americanized dub, is the sixth episode of the 1998 series.
episodes.title: Milk's Appraise Anything Team

episodes.synopsis: Milk's Boy Knife (Japanese: ミルクの少年ナイフの巻), known as "The Boy and the Close Shave" in the Americanized dub, is the seventh episode of the 1998 series.
episodes.title: Milk's Boy Knife

episodes.synopsis: The Stolen Fighting Spirit (Japanese: 盗まれた闘魂の巻), also known as "Solid Rocky" in the Americanized dub, is the eighth episode of the 1998 series.
episodes.title: The Stolen Fighting Spirit

episodes.synopsis: Tomyamkun Illusion (Japanese: トムヤムクン・イリュージョンの巻), known as "The Stink, The Stew... I'm High!" in the Americanized dub, is the ninth episode of the 1998 series.
episodes.title: Tomyamkun Illusion

episodes.synopsis: Mice Die 2 Times (Japanese: ねずみは２度死ぬの巻), also known as "Mice Die Twice" in the straight dub and "Of Mice, Men, and Milk" in the Americanized dub, is the tenth episode of the 1998 series.
episodes.title: Mice Die Twice

episodes.synopsis: The President That Dashes Through Time (Japanese: 時をかける大統領の巻), known as "Time and Time Again" in the Americanized dub, is the eleventh episode of the 1998 series.
episodes.title: The President That Dashes Through Time

episodes.synopsis: Tetsuko's Blast of a First Date (Japanese: テツコのブッとび初デートの巻), also known as "Hungry for Love" in the Americanized dub, is the twelfth episode of the 1998 series.
episodes.title: Tetsuko's Blast of a First Date

episodes.synopsis: Hunting Middle-Aged Men In the Name of Heaven (Japanese: 天に代わっておやじがりの巻), also known as "Pretty, Witty and Gay" in the Americanized dub, is the thirteenth episode of the 1998 series.
episodes.title: Hunting Middle-Aged Men in the Name of Heaven

episodes.synopsis: Farewell, Milk Chan (Japanese: さよならミルクちゃんの巻), also known as "It's Lonely At the Top" in the Americanized dub, is the fourteenth and last episode of the 1998 series.
episodes.title: Farewell Milk-Chan
